Summary for tournament play: Conditions look favorable for the entire tee-time window (7:30 AM–1:50 PM). Temps climb steadily from the low-70s at first tee off to upper-70s by early afternoon, with light-to-moderate winds out of the E/ENE (3–9 mph) building slightly as the day progresses. Precipitation chances stay low all morning (6–8%) and creep up modestly into early afternoon (12–17%), but nothing suggests a high risk of rain delays — just keep an eye on that gradual increase in precip probability for groups finishing play in the early evening.
